layout.body:
Dear Team,
As we prepare for this year's Year-End Celebration on Friday, December 15 at The Grand Ballroom from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM, we want to ensure the event reflects everyone's preferences. We're reaching out to gather your input on several key aspects of the evening.
For dining options, please let us know whether you would prefer a buffet or plated dinner, and don't forget to mention any dietary restrictions we should accommodate. Regarding entertainment, we're considering either a live band or a DJ and would appreciate knowing which option you would enjoy more.
To help us finalize arrangements, please share your preferences by Friday, November 24. Your feedback is invaluable in creating an enjoyable celebration for all. We look forward to hearing from you and to celebrating our collective achievements together.
Best regards,
The Events Team

questions.stem: What is the main goal of this email?

options.A: To announce the promotion of team members
options.B: To request financial contributions for the event
options.C: To collect preferences for the celebration
options.D: To inform about changes to the company policy

questions.analysis: What is the main goal of this email? 原文：We want to ensure the event reflects everyone's preferences. We're reaching out to gather your input on several key aspects of the evening. 解析：这封邮件的目的是收集大家对年终庆典的偏好与意见。 A 宣布升职、B 要求捐款、D 通知公司政策变更，均与原文不符。

options.A: The date of the company holiday

questions.analysis: What feedback should be provided? 原文： dining options: buffet or plated dinner + dietary restrictions entertainment: live band or DJ 解析：需要反馈的是餐饮和娱乐选择。 A 假期日期、B 工作时间、D 办公室搬迁计划，文中均未提及。
